title: Weight of the World
logline: A reckless salvage crew accidentally activates an old gravitational stabilizer near a dead system, and a retired legend needs a pilot to shut it down before it crushes the local mining habitats.

roles.description: Knows exactly what the terraformer is because they helped shut it down fifty years ago.
Lied about their salvage charter to get close to the core.
A massive, spinning ancient construct creating brutal gravity sheer.
A fragile orbital colony slowly being pulled apart by the tides.
A heavy tug that pulled the terraformer's control rods.
An ancient, logic-driven guard unit protecting the core.
The obsolete automated systems still defending the terraformer.

public_situation: The {role:mining_habitat} is issuing emergency distress calls as wild gravitational fluctuations tear their mooring lines apart.
private_truth: The salvager bypassed the safety locks on the stabilizer to steal its rare platinum control rods, causing the system to run wild.

beats.public_change: The terraformer begins emitting a low, rhythmic hum that shakes every ship in the sector.

missions.reason: The legend needs the pilot to brave the gravity tides and scan the core to see which rods are missing.
missions.private_fact: The scan wakes up the old security grid.

missions.reason: The pilot must destroy the drone that awakened to protect the damaged core.
missions.private_fact: The drone's shielding is almost impenetrable to standard lasers.

beats.public_change: The gravity sheer rips the first orbital block off the mining habitat.

missions.reason: The salvager, pretending to be innocent, asks the pilot to deliver emergency evacuation protocols to the habitat.
missions.private_fact: They just want the habitat empty so they can strip it too.

missions.reason: The pilot must pay the salvager's panicked crewmate to hand over the control rods while the salvager is busy prepping to flee.
missions.private_fact: The crewmate knows the salvager plans to leave them behind to save weight.

beats.public_change: The terraformer starts dragging nearby asteroid fragments into a dangerous, high-speed debris ring around itself, shredding any ships caught inside.

missions.reason: The pilot must shoot down another defense drone and recover its targeting logic core.
missions.private_fact: The core is required to interface with the terraformer to reinsert the rods.

beats.public_change: The habitat is hours away from complete structural collapse.

missions.reason: The salvager intercepts the pilot, and the legend pays the pilot to destroy the salvager's heavily armed tug so they can return the rods in peace.
missions.private_fact: The salvager hails the pilot, offering millions in raw platinum to just let the terraformer crush the habitat so they can mine the debris.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the salvager and helps return the rods.
resolutions.summary: The terraformer powers down. The habitat is saved, the legend fades back into obscurity, and the pilot is a local hero.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot defeated a greedy salvager and shut down an ancient gravity weapon before it crushed a colony.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the salvager's offer.
resolutions.summary: The terraformer crushes the habitat into a dense metallic core. Thousands die, but the pilot and salvager get unbelievably rich mining the wreckage.
The gravity sheer consumes everything. The habitat, the salvager, and the legend are all pulled into the core's crushing embrace.

loose_threads.detail: The old stabilizer's architecture perfectly matches the foundation blocks of the sector's capital station.
The terraformer's control rods have fresh calibration marks dated twenty years after it was supposedly shut down forever.

radio_hooks: {role:mining_habitat} reports extreme orbital degradation; requests immediate aid.
Unregistered gravity wells detected in Sector 4.

voice_direction.retired_legend: Gravelly, tired, speaks like they've seen this all before.
